selection_rationale: Multi-shift and total-matched uniform controls on the same 30 frozen mothers as the original fate campaign. Pre-registered before execution: instant drift a_1 per shift vector equals the shifted-state J_pre recorded in preregistered_multishift_predictions.json (dose-response: (2,1) mild, (5,31)/(17,12)/(23,42) strong negative); long-horizon q_B decreases directionally for every shift; uniform arms flatten structure at live/equilibrium totals (equilibrium and live totals differ by <0.2%, so uniform_eq - uniform_live isolates total, adapted - uniform_eq isolates equilibrium spatial structure at equal total). Confirmatory screen for the alignment mechanism.
interpretation: fate endpoints for pre-registered displacement vectors and total-matched structure-removal controls; mother-level paired analysis
